```rust
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::cmp::Reverse;
use std::collections::BinaryHeap;

struct Video {
    content: String,
    views: i32,
    likes: i32,
    dislikes: i32,
}



struct VideoSharingPlatform {
    videos: HashMap<i32, Video>,
    next_video_id: i32,
    next_video_ids: BinaryHeap<Reverse<i32>>,
}

impl VideoSharingPlatform {

    fn new() -> Self {
        VideoSharingPlatform {
            videos: HashMap::new(),
            next_video_id: 0,
            next_video_ids: BinaryHeap::new(),
        }
    }
    
    fn upload(&mut self, video: String) -> i32 {
        let video_id;
        if self.next_video_ids.is_empty() {
            self.videos.insert(self.next_video_id, Video { content: video, views: 0, likes: 0, dislikes: 0 });
            video_id = self.next_video_id;
            self.next_video_id += 1;
        } else {
            let Reverse(vid) = self.next_video_ids.pop().unwrap();
            video_id = vid;
            self.videos.insert(vid, Video { content: video, views: 0, likes: 0, dislikes: 0 });
        }

        video_id
    }
    
    fn remove(&mut self, video_id: i32) {
        if self.videos.contains_key(&video_id) {
            self.videos.remove(&video_id);
            self.next_video_ids.push(Reverse(video_id));
        }
    }
    
    fn watch(&mut self, video_id: i32, start_minute: i32, end_minute: i32) -> String {
        if let Some(video) = self.videos.get_mut(&video_id) {
            video.views += 1;
            if end_minute >= video.content.len() as i32 {
                return video.content[start_minute as usize .. video.content.len()].to_string();
            }
            return video.content[start_minute as usize .. (end_minute + 1) as usize].to_string();
        }
        return "-1".to_string();
    }
    
    fn like(&mut self, video_id: i32) {
        if let Some(video) = self.videos.get_mut(&video_id) {
            video.likes += 1;
        }
    }
    
    fn dislike(&mut self, video_id: i32) {
        if let Some(video) = self.videos.get_mut(&video_id) {
            video.dislikes += 1;
        }
    }
    
    fn get_likes_and_dislikes(&self, video_id: i32) -> Vec<i32> {
        if let Some(video) = self.videos.get(&video_id) {
            return vec![video.likes, video.dislikes];
        }
        return vec![-1];
    }
    
    fn get_views(&self, video_id: i32) -> i32 {
        if let Some(video) = self.videos.get(&video_id) {
            return video.views;
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```
